title: 虚构海岸城市旅行海报
summary: 以大色块、几何建筑和丝网印刷肌理构成旅行海报。
prompt: An original editorial travel poster for a fictional coastal city named SOLA. A sunlit terracotta stairway descends between white modernist houses toward a turquoise harbor, distant sailboat and hill, one small cyclist for scale. Sophisticated flat screen-print look with subtle paper grain, palette of coral red, cobalt, cream and sea green, strong geometric composition and negative space. One small readable heading SOLA at the top, no logos, no real place names, vertical 3:4 poster.
